name: Pualani (2017 livery)
description: White fuselage with a silver-gray lei of flowers across the middle; behind the wing the aft fuselage turns purple, its front a fringe of magenta flowers, wrapping the tail cone; 'HAWAIIAN' in widely spaced purple capitals over the forward windows; the fin purple shading to magenta at the tip, with Pualani (a woman's face in profile, a coral hibiscus in her dark hair) in white, facing forward.

logos.description: Pualani ('flower of the sky'): a Hawaiian woman's face in profile, white, facing forward, her dark-purple hair framing it with a coral hibiscus behind her ear, filling the aft fin.

titles.style: Widely spaced, upright medium-weight capitals in purple, over the forward windows behind the door.

B712.note: Measured on the 717 (N483HA, left side, level, 2019-03-23; N490HA, right side from above, 2021-10-08; N488HA, 2022): 'HAWAIIAN' large under the windows; the lei as gray flowers on the upper body, a spray above the forward windows and a cluster across the windows round the overwing exits, down toward the wing root (artwork reduced to two patches, the same both sides); no magenta fringe: the aft purple starts at the fin's root on the crown, lilac petals at its front, and runs forward under the engine to the wing's trailing edge low down; lilac petals across the middle of each nacelle.

notes: Drawn from N208HA (A321neo, Nov 2023, climbing and tilted) and checked against the A330 N382HA in August 2025, after the Alaska Air Group merger: the Hawaiian brand and this scheme carry on. The gray lei and the magenta flowers are artwork reduced to bands. Hawaiian's 787-9s were moved to Alaska's 'global' livery; the A330s, A321neos and 717s keep this one. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on N208HA: the title runs from just behind the forward door (x 0.144) to just ahead of the second door (0.298), about 1 m longer than first drawn; its baseline sits about half a window's height above the window tops, as drawn. Drawn on the A321neo, the type it was measured on; the A330-200 is about as common in the fleet (and the 717), but the only recent A330 photo (N382HA, 2025) is an oblique ramp view, too foreshortened to measure from: on the A330 the title starts nearer the nose as a share (about 0.09 on that photo). The lei and the flower fringe are artwork reduced to bands, left as polygons. On the 717 (sources 3-5, 2019-2022) the lei is there too, as gray flowers on the upper body from behind the title back to the engine (faint in flat light: N483HA's left side shows none), and the purple with lilac flowers starts at the engine with no magenta fringe on the body; drawn on the 717's shape these come from `types.B712`, measured on N483HA (side-on) and N490HA, with the title under the windows as there.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory). The 2017 livery refreshed the long-running Pualani scheme; Hawaiian became part of Alaska Air Group in September 2024.
